notes.title: Gameplay adjustments, AI and performance improvements
notes.content:
Nameless machines,

The latest series of updates contains a lot of AI improvements, balance changes, general quality of life and gameplay improvements, bug fixes and more:


 New visual design of nameless machines
 Repairing nanobots are now visibly equipped on the nameless machine
 AI movement and decision making have been improved
 AI downtimes have been reduced to improve their action fluidity, which also increases the difficulty
 Base cooldowns of weapons and offensive tactical gadgets have been reduced
 Quality of life changes of Curve UI
 Performance improvements across the board
 Balance changes
 Bug fixes, other improvements and more


Some of the performance impacting changes are experimental and might need further tweaking - in case of performance decrease or stuttering, feel free to leave your feedback or bug report on the official Discord server.

Thank you!

notes.title: New progression system, balance changes and bug fixes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Cgu6lTl6T_c;full][/previewyoutube]

A new Fine Tuning system has been added to the game:

You can spend credits to tune your core's resonance at a curve.

Each fine tuning improves your stats by a small percentage, but the effect scales with the upgrade materials you gather and apply throughout your journey, along with your active consumables.

Improving resonance also slightly reduces the percentage of damage you take.


Additionally, more upgrade materials have been scattered throughout the game, along with several balance changes and bug fixes.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Gameplay adjustments and minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Nameless machines,

This update contains big object management fixes, balance changes, general UI and gameplay improvements, minor bug fixes:


 The UI now shows how long the enemy remains staggered when their posture is broken
 Damage to enemies with broken posture has been drastically increased
 A successful parry restores the energy used to perform it, while a perfect parry replenishes 25% of your maximum energy
 An optional direction indicator has been added
 Multiple enhancements to enemy attack animations
 Object management improvements, adjustments and fixes
 Minor balance changes
 Minor bug fixes and improvements


Some of the performance impacting changes are experimental and might need further tweaking - in case of performance decrease or stuttering, feel free to leave your feedback or bug report on the official Discord server.

Thank you!

notes.title: Content and balance update
notes.content:
Nameless machines,

This update contains new gadgets, AI improvements, as well as balance changes, various stability and performance fixes and improvements:


 Two new gadgets, they can also be found in the demo
 New AI combat behaviors
 Block and parry feedback improvements
 Energy regeneration rate has been significantly increased
 New controls option - automatically reset aim direction
 Some areas of UI have been polished
 Some new quality of life features
 Enemies don't cancel a mobility action midway to swap to an attack anymore
 Minor bug fixes and improvements


Thank you!

notes.title: Performance and balance update
notes.content:
Nameless machines,

This update contains balance changes, various stability and performance fixes and improvements:


 Loading times have been greatly reduced, resulting in a way smoother experience
 Dynamic object management has been improved - some situations where you might have experienced stuttering should be way less likely
 AI has been greatly optimized - the performance has been trippled at very least
 Energy regeneration and consumption in multiple cases has been adjusted, you should be able to perform more actions in general
 Minor bug fixes and improvements


Thank you!

notes.title: The Curvature Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Cgu6lTl6T_c;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have any questions, encounter any problems, or just want to chat, 
please join me on the Curvature's Official Community Discord server!

The game's file might be marked as an unknown software by your Windows Defender, or your Antivirus. You might need to whitelist it, in order to start the game.

This issue will be resolved with time.

Another known issue is shader compilation stuttering on the first start up. If the game stutters when first time run, or after a new graphics driver update, just try to restart it and it should run just fine.

Thank you for playing!
